name: Posey Cottage
address: Posey Cottage, Posey, Graiguenamanagh, Co. Kilkenny
agent: John Doherty, Property Partners Doherty Buggy, New Ross
questions: The features list says 0.24 ha and the description says 0.42 ha / 1.03 ac; can you send the folio map? From the aerials we make it roughly 0.33–0.38 ha. Is the boundary stock-proof all round, especially along the R705 and the field to the east (we have two dogs)?

Who works the farmyard about 70 m north of the house, and what is kept there (cattle, silage, slurry)? Are any of the three planning applications BuyerIQ shows within 1 km for that yard or the fields next to the house?
Is there a floor plan? Does Bedroom Four open next to the 1.74 × 1.45 m shower room, and could that shower room be enlarged into a walk-in shower for older parents?
When were the well water last tested and the septic tank last desludged or inspected? How old is the oil boiler, and is the gas hob on bottled LPG?
Has a radon test been done? BuyerIQ shows one critical finding for this Eircode that sits behind its paywall.

ai.why: 215 m², four doubles, four bathrooms and two ground-floor bedrooms on an acre behind gates at €425k. Held back by a working farmyard about 70 m north, the R705 about 15 m from the front, and Kilkenny's ED about 35 minutes away.

electricity.detail: Likely connected; not stated, but the house is lived in and the garage has power and sockets.

water.detail: Private well, stated in the listing's services. Ask for a recent water test.

sewer.detail: Own septic tank, stated in the listing's services. Ask its age and when it was last desludged or inspected.

internet.detail: Full fibre at the address per BuyerIQ ('Fast broadband — 390 Mb full fibre'); the listing doesn't mention broadband. Provider not confirmed; the Borris area next door is in NBI's rollout.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: Two on the ground floor: Bedroom Four (2.89 × 2.93 m with a walk-in wardrobe), listed next to the shower room off the connecting hall, and Bedroom Three / Living Room (3.36 × 3.06 m plus a 2.41 × 1.23 m recess); no floor plan is published, so the layout is from the room list.

bedsNote: Two doubles on the ground floor and two en-suite doubles upstairs, plus a study (2.93 × 2.36 m) and a home office (4.43 × 2.96 m) upstairs
heating: Oil-fired central heating, with multi-fuel stoves in the sitting room and kitchen
tagline: A 215 m² four-bed, four-bath house with two ground-floor bedrooms on about an acre behind electric gates, beside the R705 3.5 km north of Graiguenamanagh.

pros.detail: About €1,977/m² for 215 m²; stamp duty about €4,250.

pros.text: Room for six: 215 m², four doubles, four bathrooms
pros.detail: Two en-suite doubles upstairs (master 4.35 × 4.32 m), a ground-floor shower room and a guest WC, plus a study and a 4.43 × 2.96 m home office.

pros.text: Two ground-floor bedrooms by a shower room
pros.detail: Bedroom Four (2.89 × 2.93 m plus walk-in wardrobe) is listed beside the ground-floor shower room; Bedroom Three (3.36 × 3.06 m plus recess) is a second option.

pros.text: About an acre behind electric gates
pros.detail: Stated as 0.42 ha / 1.03 ac (the features list's 0.24 ha looks like a typo); a tree-lined drive, mature planting, a south-west patio and a 35 m² double garage with power.
Mixed ETB secondary in Graiguenamanagh, ranked third among mixed schools nationally in the Irish Times progression tables (Jan 2026).
About 4 km by road: Doran's SuperValu, Aldi, a health centre, two pharmacies and two primary schools; Borris is about 6 km north.

pros.text: Ready to live in, with some character
pros.detail: BER C3 (208 kWh/m²/yr), a double-height hall with a tall arched window, an arched stone fireplace in the kitchen, a stone porch and views to the Blackstairs.
BuyerIQ shows 390 Mb full fibre for R95 F8Y1.

cons.detail: Satellite shows large sheds and a stack of wrapped silage bales about 70–100 m north of the house, reached by a lane at the junction just past the garage; expect smells, slurry and machinery.

cons.text: Beside the R705, about 15 m from the road
cons.detail: The house front is roughly 15 m from the R705 Borris road behind a hedge, and the site is a long strip along it; gates help with the dogs, but traffic is at the boundary.
Muine Bheag station is about 17 km (roughly 20 minutes) with about 7 weekday trains, 1h15–1h25 to Heuston; Thomastown is about 22 km. Dublin by car is about 1h50 per the listing.
St Luke's, Kilkenny is about 29 km by road; University Hospital Waterford is about 47 km.

cons.text: Oil, a private well and a septic tank
cons.detail: All stated in the listing; the well water and the tank's condition need checking, and oil heating will need replacing in time.
Bedroom Four is about 8.5 m² and the ground-floor shower room 1.74 × 1.45 m with an enclosed cubicle; the parents would need one of these and stairs are needed for the en-suites.
The kitchen/dining/family room is 2.93 × 4.54 m plus 2.58 × 2.66 m, about 20 m², though the 6.9 × 4.35 m sitting room and 3.9 × 3.6 m sunroom add space.

cons.text: Site size conflicts; no floor plan
cons.detail: The listing gives both 0.24 ha and 0.42 ha; a rough estimate from the aerials is 0.33–0.38 ha (0.8–0.95 ac). No floor plan is published.
